children.label: Children and adolescents

adultClinical.label: Clinical symptom cohorts
adultClinical.criterion: Clinical symptomatic samples outside athlete-only or military-only recruitment. Mostly adults; some span adolescents/adults. Symptom duration varies and is not uniformly greater than three months.

glucoseMetabolites.label: Glucose uptake and metabolites

ppcsMetabolism.label: Metabolism after the acute phase

ppcsTracer.criterion: Yoo and Yoen clinical symptomatic mTBI DCE studies; durations are not uniformly greater than three months.
